_note: Card scenes, round 1: a style test. Scenes are a pool, not bound to card names: `tag` and `cards` only choose which real cards show a scene here. `cards` is one program or event and one building, so each scene is seen in both art windows. Onyx, Adversary, Discord and Unity are no card tag: their cards are the nearest fit by name. Preamble b is a with the painted line in place of the photograph.

preambles.a: Photorealistic near-future concept art, as if a documentary photograph from 2040. Cinematic wide shot, single clear subject centred with empty margin above and below, muted desaturated palette with one warm accent light, fine industrial detail, slight film grain. No text, logos, UI, or close-up faces.
preambles.b: Near-future concept art, a painted science-fiction illustration with visible brushwork, set in 2040. Cinematic wide shot, single clear subject centred with empty margin above and below, muted desaturated palette with one warm accent light, fine industrial detail, slight film grain. No text, logos, UI, or close-up faces.
